values.applicableLaws: [{"law": "Constitution of Kenya 2010, Articles 31 (privacy) and 35 (access to information)", "url": "https://new.kenyalaw.org/legislation/", "checkedOn": "2026-11-02", "verifiedAgainstOfficialText": false, "note": "named in the compliance baseline"}, {"law": "Access to Information Act, 2016 (No. 31 of 2016) and Access to Information (General) Regulations, 2023", "url": "https://ombudsman.go.ke/access-information-center", "checkedOn": "2026-11-02", "verifiedAgainstOfficialText": false, "note": "regulator: Commission on Administrative Justice"}, {"law": "Data Protection Act, 2019 (No. 24 of 2019) and the 2021 General, Registration, and Complaints Handling and Enforcement Regulations", "url": "https://www.odpc.go.ke/data-protection-laws-kenya/", "checkedOn": "2026-11-02", "verifiedAgainstOfficialText": false, "note": "regulator: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner; registration, DPIA and transfer duties not yet assessed against Mzizi's actual processing"}, {"law": "Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act, 2018 (No. 5 of 2018) as amended by the Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes (Amendment) Act, 2025 (No. 17 of 2025)", "url": "https://ke-cirt.go.ke/law-regulations/", "checkedOn": "2026-11-02", "verifiedAgainstOfficialText": false, "note": "web search on 2026-11-02: assent 15 Oct 2025, commencement 4 Nov 2025; challenged in the High Court with conservatory orders on some provisions, and one aggregator reports a July 2026 declaration of unconstitutionality for two provisions: the current legal effect must be read from the judgment"}, {"law": "Copyright Act, 2001 (Cap. 130) as amended", "url": "https://new.kenyalaw.org/legislation/", "checkedOn": "2026-11-02", "verifiedAgainstOfficialText": false, "note": "rights, licences and database questions per source"}]

values.openQuestions: Open for counsel: whether Mzizi must register as a data controller or processor with the ODPC and whether a DPIA is needed; lawful basis and retention for public-office holder data; effect of the 2025 cybercrimes amendment and the litigation on automated access to public sites; licences and rights holders for government publications (no source has an assessed licence yet); where raw documents, backups and logs are hosted and which AI providers see source content.
